Interface DBConnection

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
public interface DBConnection extends AutoCloseable
A simplified JDBC connection with just the methods needed by MSFX.
Author:
Miquel Sas

    • getMetaData

      DatabaseMetaData getMetaData() throws SQLException
      Gives access to the information about the database, for instance to read the structure of existing tables. It is the JDBC object, meant to be used only within the db package.
      Returns:
      A DatabaseMetaData object that contains information about the database.
      Throws:
      SQLException - If an error occurs.
